versions.guide:
Find the entrance to the labyrinth

The gates to the labyrinth are to the east of the new Green Clan area in the city suburbs.

Open the labyrinth entrance

You do not need a key to open the labyrinth gates.

Find the exit gates

The exit from the labyrinth is in its eastern sector. Be careful in the labyrinth: there are many creatures there including magic ones and these are difficult to spot.

Open the exit gates

You do not need a key to open the exit gates.

Going through labyrinth

The Woodsfolk of the Green Clan have moved home. They have gone to the mountain valleys in the southern part of Karansul's domain. You can only reach it through the labyrinth in the hills surrounding the city.
